author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: **Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator** We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors) - work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!

author: Nellyslife
title: HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines)
content: HIRING: Freelance Illustrator & Graphic Designer (Philippines). Remote · Project-based · Start ASAP. Apply by email only: team.nellyslife@gmail.com. Send your portfolio, rates and availability, with the subject line “Freelance Illustrator / Designer – [Your Name]”. DMs and comments won’t be considered. Please read the requirements in the graph below BEFORE applying to this job. We are seeking a versatile Illustrator to join our team on a contract basis. This role will involve creating high-quality designs for our products. Remote Work Setup Minimum of 1 to 3 months, with the possibility of renewal. Starting at Php 35,000 for the first month, with the potential to increase to Php 45,000.

author: Jobs.com
title: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote
content: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote. https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm Role Overview: We are looking for talented Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists who can create high-quality artwork from reference images while introducing creative variations and maintaining the character’s identity. This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals with strong visual skills and a portfolio that demonstrates creativity, versatility, and attention to detail. What You’ll Do: Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images. Compensation: Paid in USD (per approved task). Project Duration: 10–12 weeks. Commitment: 20–40 hours/week.
